= Shared inline escape policy
:experimental:

\*Bold\* and \_Italic\_ and \`Mono\` and \#Mark\#.

\**Bold** and \__Italic__ and \``Mono`` and \##Mark##.

\^super^ and \~sub~ and *active*.

link:https://example.org[\*Literal\*] and link:https://example.org[*Rich*].

\kbd:[Ctrl+*C*] and \btn:[*Save*] and \menu:File[*Open*].

\footnote:inactive[*Literal*] and \anchor:inactive-anchor[*Literal*].

\xref:missing[*Literal*] and \indexterm2:[*Literal*].

footnote:active[Registered once.]

[subs="specialchars,macros"]
\*Literal\* and ((Term (R))).

[subs="specialchars,quotes"]
\footnote:disabled[*Rich*] and \*Literal\*.
